title: Echoes of the Abyss
brief: Original-IP metroidvania game (sub-genre: metroidvania). Capture the core mechanics and game-feel of "Super Metroid" (critically acclaimed, 96%) — but with your OWN original name, theme, characters and art. Do NOT reference or reuse that title's IP. SIGNATURE MECHANIC for this genre: interconnected map + ability-gated traversal + backtracking. MUST SHIP COMPLETE: a working menu (title + difficulty + how-to + settings via FFG.Shell), the page control bar (fullscreen/mute/pause), a clear win AND lose state, readable HUD, and polished feel — it must play start-to-finish with no manual fixes.

M0.done_when: design doc written: core loop, verbs, scope, art direction, definition_of_done

M1.done_when: core loop genuinely playable in ONE level: structure+feel green, no crash

M2.done_when: every verb in the design doc implemented and survives the play-bot

M3.done_when: multiple levels + progression + a real difficulty curve; everything reachable

M4.done_when: menu + audio + game-feel/juice; vision fidelity high; zero crashes

M5.done_when: deep QA: structure+feel+fidelity+review all green across repeated playthroughs

design_doc.title: Echoes of the Abyss
design_doc.core_loop: Navigate a vast underground alien ruin as a lone explorer equipped with a modular exosuit. Scan ancient glyphs to unlocksuit upgrades (double-jump, dash, grapple beam, phase-shift), which open previously inaccessible areas. Combat hostile bio-mechanical guardians using an energy weapon that drains the same resource pool as your movement abilities, forcing risk/reward decisions. Defeat zone bosses to claim core fragments that restore sections of your suit's memory, revealing the fate of the civilization that built this place. Backtrack through familiar areas with new abilities to reach the deepest chamber and choose: escape with the knowledge, or activate the ruin's dormant systems.
design_doc.scope: IN: 5 interconnected biome zones (Crystal Caverns, Fungal Warren, Flooded Depths, Geothermal Core, Celestial Vault), 4 major ability upgrades (double-jump boots, dash module, grapple beam, phase cloak), 5 boss encounters, ~20 enemy types, health/energy pickups, save stations, map system with fog-of-war, 2 endings (escape or activate). OUT: dialogue/NPCs, crafting, skill trees, procedural generation, multiplayer, side-quests, shops/currency, separate weapon types (single upgradable arm cannon only), voiced cutscenes (environmental storytelling only).
design_doc.art_direction: Moody pixel art (16-bit inspired, 320x180 base resolution scaled 3x), palette of deep purples, cyan accents, bioluminescent greens, and warm amber lighting for geothermal areas. Oppressive atmosphere with isolated moments of alien beautyâ€”crystalline formations, glowing fungi, ancient machinery humming with residual power. Player sprite: sleek exosuit with glowing visor and modular attachment points that visually change with upgrades. Enemies: biomechanical hybrids of organic tissue and corroded metal, pulsing with energy cores.

milestone_plan.M1: Vertical slice: Crystal Caverns zone playable start-to-finish, basic run/jump/shoot, one mini-boss, double-jump upgrade gated behind it, backtracking proof-of-concept, FFG.Shell menu integration (title/difficulty/controls), fullscreen/mute/pause functional, basic HUD (health, energy, mini-map corner), win state = reach exit marker, lose state = health depletes.
milestone_plan.M2: Core mechanics complete: all 4 upgrades functional with tight controls, ability-energy economy balanced, wall-jump + dash + grapple + phase-shift implemented, 2 additional zones (Fungal Warren + Flooded Depths) with unique traversal challenges, save/load system, map reveals explored tiles.
milestone_plan.M3: Content complete: all 5 zones built and interconnected, 5 bosses placed with unique patterns, ~20 enemy types distributed, all ability-gates placed to enforce intended progression, 2 endings implemented (player choice at final chamber), lore terminals scannable (text-only environmental storytelling).
milestone_plan.M4: Polish pass: particle effects for abilities/impacts, screen shake on damage/dash, ambient audio loops per zone, enemy telegraph animations clear, health/energy UI pulses when critical, boss intro stingers, death animation + respawn at last save, smooth camera follow with look-ahead, hitbox refinement, difficulty modes adjust enemy damage/health.
milestone_plan.M5: Ship-ready: full playthrough QA (both endings reachable, no soft-locks), performance stable at 60fps, all FFG.Shell requirements met (menu navigation, settings persist, how-to-play screen shows all verbs), HUD readable at all resolutions, final trailer-ready build exported, itch.io page prepared with screenshots/GIFs, launch.

definition_of_done: Player can complete full run from title screen to either ending in 60-90 minutes without manual intervention.
All 4 suit upgrades unlock in intended sequence and visibly change player sprite.
Map reveals 5 distinct interconnected zones; backtracking required at least 3 times to progress.
5 boss fights beatable on Normal difficulty by playtesters with clear attack patterns.
Zero soft-locks: player cannot get permanently stuck without abilities or save access.
FFG.Shell menu allows title screen return, difficulty selection (Easy/Normal/Hard scales enemy stats Â±30%), how-to-play lists all 9 verbs, settings toggle fullscreen/mute.
Page control bar (fullscreen/mute/pause) functional and visible.
HUD displays current health (segmented bar), energy (segmented bar), mini-map (corner), and current zone name on entry.
Win state: reaching final chamber and choosing an ending triggers credits roll. Lose state: health depleting triggers death animation and respawn at last save station.
Audio: 5 zone ambient loops, boss battle music, ability/weapon SFX, damage/pickup feedback.
Performance: stable 60fps on mid-tier hardware, no crashes during 90min playthrough.
Two endings accessible based on player choice at finale (no missable content locks either ending).
